caption: The drawing is a grayscale depiction of the front façade of a mission-style building, characterized by symmetrical architectural elements and rendered in black and white pencil or ink. The building features a prominent, scalloped parapet at the top crowned by a small belfry with a cross. Below the parapet is a small recessed niche, and at the center is a circular window. The main entrance is an arched doorway flanked by two pairs of columns and topped by a decorative entablature. On each side of the entrance are small rectangular niches, each with a protruding feature possibly representing a light or a Sconce. The structure's exterior is simple, with minimal ornamentation except for the arches and columns. At the bottom of the page, there is stylized ribbon-like text that reads “1798 Mision San Luis Rey de Francia.” The background is blank, with no surrounding scenery or context displayed.
title: Mision San Luis Rey de Francia
